payload.documentation: LAND & INFRASTRUCTURE: Land details (owned/leased/allotted in Acres) are in chatbot_cooperative_land. Office building info (has_building) is found in most sector tables. Join using ncd_id.

GLOBAL QUERY FILTERS: For ALL queries, you MUST apply: status=1 (Active), is_draft=0 (Not a draft), is_approved=1 (Approved), and is_multi_state=0 (unless the user specifically asks for multi-state). is_approved=2 means rejected.

PACS / LAMPS / FSS SECTOR: Detailed information for PACS, LAMPS, and FSS is in chatbot_cooperative_pacs. Join using ncd_id. It includes storage capacity, fertilizer distribution, and grain storage projects.
FISHERY SECTOR: Catch data (in Metric Tonnes/MT), cooling units, and marketing details are in chatbot_cooperative_registration_fishery. Join using ncd_id.

MPACS are the PACS society which are registered after 2023-02-15 , MDCS are the Dairy cooperative societies which are registered after 2023-02-15 , MFCS are the Fishery cooperative societies which are registered after 2023-02-15

DATA DICTIONARY - FLAGS: functional_status (1=Functional, 2=Under Liquidation, 3=Non Functional); status (1=active, 0=deleted); is_approved (1=Approved, 0=Pending, 2=Rejected); sector_of_operation (1=Credit, 2=Non-Credit); is_multi_state/is_coastal/is_msme/is_profit_making (1=Yes, 0=No).

TERMINOLOGY & ABBREVIATIONS: PACS - Primary Agricultural Credit Society; DCCB - District Central Cooperative Bank; SCB - State Cooperative Bank; SCARDB - State Cooperative Agricultural and Rural Development Bank; UCB - Urban Cooperative Bank; FSS - Farmers Service Societies; LAMPS - Large Area Multipurpose Society; NAFCARD - National Cooperative Agricultural & Rural Development Banks Federation; NAFSCOB - National Federation of State Cooperative Banks Limited; NAFCUB - National Federation of Urban Cooperative Banks & Credit Societies; PCARDB - Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank; SCU - Supply Chain Unit; MSCS - Multistate cooperative society; PMKSK - Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samridhi Kendra; LGS - largest Grain Storage Project; Common Service Centres (CSC); Farmer Producer Organization (FPO); BCP - Bulk Consumer Pump; MSCS - Multistate cooperative society.
DAIRY SECTOR: Information on milk collection (in Litres), transport, and processing is in chatbot_cooperative_registration_dairy. Join using ncd_id.

TERMINOLOGY: PACS (Primary Agricultural Credit Society), LAMPS (Large Area Multipurpose Society), FSS (Farmers Service Societies), DCCB (District Central Cooperative Bank), LGS (Largest Grain Storage), PMKSK (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samridhi Kendra).
MEMBER DEMOGRAPHICS: For questions about member counts, gender ratios, or category-wise members (SC/ST/OBC), join with chatbot_member_details_private using ncd_id.

MULTI-STATE SOCIETIES: If a question specifically asks about multi-state cooperative societies, filter by is_multi_state = '1' and join the master table with chatbot_multi_state_cooperatives on cooperative_id to retrieve the area of operation state names.
JOIN LOGIC: Join all sector-specific tables and member details to the master table using the NCD ID. (Master table Primary Key: cooperative_id, Sector table Foreign Key: ncd_id).

MEASUREMENT UNITS: Financial values (share capital, deposits, turnover) are in Rupees (Rs.); Land is in Acres; Grain/Seed/Fertilizer/Fish weight is in Metric Tonnes (MT); Milk is in Litres; Sugar crushing is in TCD.

PRIMARY MASTER TABLE: chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master is the core table. It contains the primary identity (cooperative_society_name), location (state_name, district_name, block_name, village_name), and global status of every society.
LOCATION SEARCHES: When a user asks for societies in a specific State, District, or Block, always join with the master table and filter by its state_name, district_name, or block_name columns.
SPECIAL RULES (MPACS/MFCS/MDCS): These refer to societies registered after 2023-02-15. Map accordingly using the sector and date_registration columns.
SUGAR SECTOR: Details of sugar mills, build-up area, and crushing capacity (TCD) are in chatbot_cooperative_registration_sugar. Join using ncd_id.
BANKING (UCB): Urban Cooperative Bank details such as IFSC, AEPS, core banking, and digital banking facilities are in chatbot_cooperative_registrations_ucb. Join using ncd_id.
